name: Kazaori Sumiyo
source:
Oversees student from the far-away dragon-country.

When she was young she was scouted by the court at her home country as she had good aptitude as shrine maiden, and has since been trained there. Although now she came to Voromia to see outside world a bit. Shy of strangers and timid, takes care of library on her freetime.
